title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode4 A New Year For Idols

meta.Episode: Episode4 — A New Year For Idols
meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Five! Four! Three! Two! One!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for coming to our New Year's Eve Countdown Show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're going to work hard to deliver even more fun to everyone in the new year, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, our first show for the year went so well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm happy everyone liked it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku! Rin!
Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your New Year's Show was incredible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Minori! And Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We made it too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi and Shizuku! You came too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for everything you did for us this past year. You two really helped us out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this year, we're gonna dazzle as idols, so I hope you'll be there for us then too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Same! Let's dance and sing our way through this year too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, and this may be a bit out of the blue, but I have a favor to ask you two...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm?
Sure, ask us anything♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And in the end, we decided to make a video.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we want our fans to see us at our best, so we'd like to rehearse first.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why we'd like you two to help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course I'll help!
What sort of video are you making?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just us having fun and doing New Year's stuff is the plan!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: New Year's stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah. We brought traditional games from home, like blank faces for Fukuwarai and Poetry Cards for Hyakunin Isshu Karuta.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought a video of us playing these together would be fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet it would be!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, we'll help you record an amazing video for your fans!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's get everything set up! But fair warning, I'm pretty good at these kinds of card games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm not very good at card games but... 
I think I'll be okay at Fukuwarai.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku playing Fukuwarai...
I've got a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, the camera's all set up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's try a test shoot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi everyone and a Happy New Year! We've got something special for you today! Here's how MORE MORE JUMP! celebrates the New Year!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
First, we'll play Karuta.
Haruka, would you mind being the reader?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, we'll have Rin and Airi compete against Miku and Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's give it our best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep! We're going to win for sure, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uh... This isn't really my kind of game...
I'm sorry if we lose because of me, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No pressure, Minori!
Let's just try to have fun♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that I can do!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's lay out the cards.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Okay!
